title: History index file reading
responsibility: Reads every regular file of an existing history-index directory in stable path order.

inputs.name: indexFiles.directory
inputs.description: Directory containing index.json and the index’s files.

outputs.name: indexFiles
outputs.description: Sorted relative forward-slash paths and original bytes of every regular file found recursively.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when index.json is absent, with the history-build command needed to create an index.
